info.title: Oxistream API
info.description: HTTP API of the Oxistream server. State-changing requests must send an `Origin` (or `Referer`) header of this instance.

delete.summary:
Delete the signed-in account with everything it owns: subscriptions, playlists, history,
settings and sessions. The last admin can only delete their account once no other users
remain. Single sign-on users get a new, empty account on their next sign-in.

409.description: Last admin while other users remain (`last_admin`)

422.description: Username or password does not match (`fields`)

post.summary: Change the password of a local account. Ends the account's other sessions.

403.description: Local accounts disabled, or foreign origin

422.description: Wrong current password (`fields.current_password = mismatch`) or invalid new password

post.summary: Sign in with a local account.

403.description: Account disabled, local accounts disabled, or foreign origin

post.summary: End the current session. Succeeds without a session, too.

get.summary: The signed-in account.

post.summary: Back-channel logout: the provider ends sessions server to server.
post.description:
Signs out the sessions with the token's `sid`, or all sessions of its `sub`. Configure
`{PUBLIC_URL}/api/v0/auth/oidc/backchannel-logout` as the client's back-channel logout URL.
Needs no `Origin` header or session.

400.description: Invalid, replayed or unexpected logout token

get.summary: Where the provider sends the browser back after sign-in.
get.description:
On success, starts a session and redirects to the target given to `/auth/oidc/login`.
Unknown identities get a new account; the first account of an instance becomes an admin.
Failures redirect to `/login?error=` with `oidc_denied`, `oidc_failed`, `oidc_unavailable`,
`oidc_disabled` or `account_disabled`.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error code if the provider did not authorize the request.

302.description: To the sign-in target, or to `/login?error=`

get.summary: Start single sign-on with the configured provider.
get.description:
Redirects the browser to the provider. Failures redirect to `/login?error=` with
`oidc_disabled` or `oidc_unavailable`.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Same-origin path to continue to after signing in.

302.description: To the provider's authorization endpoint, or to `/login?error=`

set-cookie.description: Short-lived `oxistream_oidc` cookie holding the login state

post.summary: Create a local account and sign in. The first account of an instance becomes an admin.

403.description: Local accounts or registration disabled, or foreign origin

get.summary: Channels the signed-in user blocked, most recently blocked first.

put.summary:
Block a channel. Its videos, shorts and playlists are left out of search, related videos and
trending, and a subscription to it ends. Subscribing to the channel again lifts the block.
Idempotent.

404.description: No such channel

delete.summary: Unblock a channel. Succeeds if not blocked, too.

get.summary: Channel header and the first page of its videos.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: A page of a channel's past, current and upcoming livestreams.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: A page of a channel's playlists.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: Search within a channel's videos.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query; required unless `continuation` is given.

400.description: Invalid channel ID or missing query

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: A page of a channel's shorts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: A page of a channel's videos.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary:
Videos of subscribed channels, newest first. Videos the user is not interested in are left
out.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Only videos of this subscribed channel (`UC…`).

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Only videos of channels in this subscription group.

400.description: Invalid continuation, limit, kind or channel

404.description: No such group of the user

get.summary:
The newest videos of a user's subscriptions as Atom. The token from
`POST /settings/feed-token` authenticates; no session is needed.

404.description: Unknown or revoked token, or disabled user

put.summary:
Mark a video as not interesting. It is left out of the subscription feed, "Continue
watching" and trending. Idempotent.

delete.summary: Show a hidden video again. Succeeds if it is not hidden, too.

get.summary: Watched videos, most recently watched first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only videos whose title or channel name contain this, ignoring case. At most 200
characters.

delete.summary: Clear the whole watch history, including resume points.

get.summary:
Started but unfinished videos, most recently watched first. Videos known to be shorts are
left out.

delete.summary:
Hide a video from "Continue watching" until it is watched again. It stays in the history
and keeps its resume point. Succeeds if it is not in the history, too.

get.summary: Whether the watch history is paused, and how long it is kept.

put.summary: Pause or resume the watch history, or change how long it is kept.

Mark a video as watched: it moves to the top of the history, finished. Recorded even while
the history is paused, as the user asked for it. Not for shorts, which have no history.

delete.summary: Remove one video from the watch history. Succeeds if it is not in there, too.

get.summary: Basic information about this instance.

The signed-in user's liked videos, most recently liked first. Likes stay on this
instance and are never sent to YouTube.
Whether the signed-in user liked a video.

put.summary: Like a video, shorts included. Idempotent; liking again keeps the original date.

404.description: No such video

delete.summary: Remove a like. Succeeds if the video was not liked, too.

get.summary: YouTube playlists the signed-in user follows, ordered by title.
Whether the signed-in user follows a YouTube playlist.

404.description: A mix (`reason` is `mix`)

put.summary:
Follow a YouTube playlist. Idempotent; new playlists are fetched in the background and
then kept up to date by the feed worker.

404.description: Mixes cannot be followed (`reason` is `mix`)

delete.summary: Stop following a YouTube playlist. Succeeds if not followed, too.

404.description: A mix (`reason` is `mix`)

put.summary: Mark the videos of a followed playlist as seen, resetting `new_video_count`.

404.description: Not followed

get.summary: The signed-in user's playlists, most recently changed first.

parameters.name: video_id
parameters.description: Report for each playlist whether it contains this video, in `contains_video`.

post.summary:
Copy a YouTube playlist into a new private playlist, which can then be edited. Copies at
most 5000 videos; unavailable ones are skipped. Like any local playlist, the copy holds each
video once: a repeated video keeps its first place.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix (`reason` is `mix`)

get.summary:
A playlist with its items. Private playlists are only visible to their owner; unlisted
ones to anyone with the ID, including anonymous users.

404.description: No such playlist, or not visible
No such playlist of the user
No such playlist of the user

put.summary: Append a video. Idempotent; a video appears at most once per playlist.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or no such video

delete.summary: Remove a video. Succeeds if it is not in the playlist, too.

404.description: No such playlist of the user

put.summary: Move a video to another position.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or video not in it

put.summary: Remember which item the owner is playing, for continuing later.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or video not in it

get.summary:
Progress of several videos, e.g. for the progress bars of a list. Videos never watched
are left out.

post.summary:
Record how far the signed-in user got into a video. Ignored while history is paused and for
videos known to be shorts.
post.description: The body is JSON, sent as `application/json` or, for `navigator.sendBeacon`, `text/plain`.

204.description: Recorded, or ignored while history is paused

get.summary: Progress of one video, to resume where the signed-in user left off.
The signed-in user's up-next queue. Guests keep theirs in the browser.

post.summary: Add entries at the start or end. A full queue loses entries at the end.

delete.summary:
Remove an entry. Succeeds if it is not queued, too, so two players taking the same
entry do not fail.

put.summary: Move an entry to another position. Succeeds if it is not queued, too.

get.summary: Resolve a YouTube URL to a video, channel or playlist ID.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: YouTube URL, path (`/@handle`, `/watch?v=…`), ID or handle.

404.description: Target does not exist

get.summary: List the signed-in user's open rooms, newest first.

post.summary:
Open a room. Anyone with its link can join through the WebSocket at
`/api/v0/rooms/{id}/ws`, speaking `RoomClientMessage` and `RoomServerMessage`. Rooms
expire a day after the last participant left.

404.description: Video not found

get.summary: Look up a room before joining it.

404.description: No such room

delete.summary: Close a room; everyone in it is disconnected.

404.description: No such room of the user

get.summary: Search videos, shorts, channels and playlists.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query; required unless `continuation` is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type, defaults to `all`. Pass the same type with `continuation`.

parameters.name: upload_date
parameters.description: Only results uploaded within this period.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Token from a previous page; it keeps the type and filters of its first page.

400.description: Missing query, unknown type or filter

get.summary: Search suggestions for a partial query; empty when YouTube fails.
The signed-in user's preferences.

patch.summary: Change some of the signed-in user's preferences.

get.summary: Whether the signed-in user has a feed URL.

post.summary: Create a personal Atom feed URL of the subscription feed; an existing one stops working.

delete.summary: Revoke the signed-in user's feed URL.

get.summary: The signed-in user's SponsorBlock preferences.

put.summary: Replace the signed-in user's SponsorBlock preferences.

get.summary:
Endless shorts to swipe through, like YouTube's shorts player. Each page continues the
current sequence and starts a new one from the next seed, interleaved. Seeds are the
signed-in user's liked shorts and the latest shorts of their subscriptions, plus trending
videos; anonymous users get trending seeds only. Nothing about the user is sent to YouTube
but the seed video IDs. Shorts of blocked channels are left out, so a page may be empty
while more follow.
The shorts player overlay of a short: its title and the full video it links to.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: YouTube video ID of the short

404.description: Not found or not a short

get.summary: The signed-in user's subscription groups, in their order.

post.summary: Create a subscription group, after the existing ones.

delete.summary: Delete a group. Its channels stay subscribed.

404.description: No such group of the user

patch.summary: Rename a group or change whether it shows on the home page.

404.description: No such group of the user

put.summary: Add a subscribed channel to a group. Idempotent.

404.description: No such group of the user, or not subscribed to the channel

delete.summary: Remove a channel from a group. Succeeds if it is not in the group, too.

404.description: No such group of the user

put.summary: Move a group to another position.

404.description: No such group of the user

get.summary: Channels the signed-in user subscribed to, ordered by name.
Download the signed-in user's subscriptions as a file.

post.description:
Accepts a YouTube Takeout `subscriptions.csv`, a NewPipe, Invidious or Piped JSON
export, or an OPML file; the format is detected from the content. Idempotent. Only
channels given by ID or `/channel/UC…` URL can be imported. New channels are fetched
by the feed worker over the following minutes.

requestBody.description: The exported file as is, at most 5 MiB

get.summary: Whether the signed-in user is subscribed to a channel.

put.summary: Subscribe to a channel. Idempotent; new channels are fetched in the background.

delete.summary: Unsubscribe from a channel. Succeeds if not subscribed, too.

get.summary: Trending videos of the instance's region (`OXISTREAM_TRENDING_REGION`).

schema.description: YouTube has no general trending list anymore, only these destination pages.

get.summary: Video details and related videos.

404.description: Not found or unavailable

get.summary: DASH manifest of a video, with all stream URLs pointing to the proxy.

404.description: Not found, unavailable, live or without playable streams

get.summary:
SponsorBlock segments of a video. The server looks them up by hash prefix, so SponsorBlock
never learns the video ID.
Seek preview thumbnails as a `WebVTT` track, with cues pointing into proxied sprite sheets.

404.description: Not found, unavailable or without storyboard

get.summary: A YouTube playlist with the first page of its videos.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix (`reason` is `mix`)

get.summary: A further page of a YouTube playlist's videos.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix

has_password.description: Local accounts have a password; single sign-on accounts do not.

password.description: The current password; required for accounts that have one.

username.description: The account's username, typed as confirmation; compared ignoring case.

entries.description: Up to 200. Entries whose key is already queued are left out, so retries are harmless.

skip_queued.description:
Also leaves out videos that are already queued, e.g. to merge a queue from before
signing in.

is_default.description: The track YouTube plays by default.

AuthCapabilities.description: Which sign-in methods this instance offers.

local_enabled.description: Local accounts with username and password.

oidc_enabled.description: Single sign-on via `OpenID` Connect, started at `/api/v0/auth/oidc/login`.

oidc_name.description: Label of the single sign-on button; `null` without single sign-on.

registration_enabled.description: New local accounts can be created.

require_login.description: Anonymous users cannot use the API or proxy.

BlockedChannel.description: A channel the signed-in user blocked.

name.description: As it was when the channel was blocked.

has_live.description: The channel has a Live tab.

has_shorts.description: The channel has a Shorts tab.

attribution.description: Source of the label, e.g. "Info from Google LLC".

help_url.description: YouTube help page about the label.

text.description: Localized explanation, e.g. "Sounds or visuals were altered or fully generated."

title.description: Localized short label, e.g. "Made with AI".

channel_ids.description: Initial channels; ones the user is not subscribed to are left out.

name.description: 1 to 50 characters, unique per user ignoring case.

oneOf.description: Default `private`.

url.description: The Atom feed URL. Only the token's hash is stored, so it is shown only once.

username.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Case-insensitive for sign-in.

DiscoveredShort.description:
A short to discover. YouTube sends no title or channel name with it; load them with
`GET /videos/{id}` when it is shown.

reason.description: Machine-readable detail, e.g. the unavailability reason.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

created_at.description: When the current feed URL was created; `null` without one.

FieldError.description: Why a request field was rejected.

FollowedPlaylist.description: A YouTube playlist the signed-in user follows, as last fetched by the feed worker.

oneOf.description: Absent for auto-generated lists like albums; `avatar` is always empty.

new_video_count.description:
Videos added since the user last opened the playlist. Only the first 500 videos of a
playlist are tracked.

title.description: `null` until the playlist was fetched once, shortly after the first follow.

unavailable.description: The last fetch failed, e.g. because the playlist was deleted or made private.

video.description:
From the metadata cache; `title` is the video ID and `channel` is absent while the
metadata is unknown.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

paused.description: Progress reports are ignored while paused; existing history stays.

retention.description:
Entries are deleted this long after they were last watched. Capped by the instance's
`history_max_retention`.

HistorySettingsUpdate.description: Fields to change; absent fields are kept.

oneOf.description: At most the instance's `history_max_retention`.

ImportFile.description: A subscription file as exported by another app.

playlist_id.description: YouTube playlist ID; mixes cannot be imported.

already_subscribed.description: Channels in the file the user was already subscribed to.

skipped.description: Entries that cannot be imported, such as handles, custom URLs or other services.

skipped_entries.description: The first skipped entries, as given in the file.

history_max_retention.description: Longest watch history retention users may pick; guests' local history follows it, too.

LikeState.description: Whether the signed-in user liked a video.

video.description: From the metadata cache: `channel` is always set; view counts are not.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

total.description: Number of liked videos in all pages.

LinkedVideo.description: A full-length video a short links to.

end_session_url.description:
For sessions started via single sign-on: the provider's end-session URL to navigate
to, which signs out there, too (RP-initiated logout). `null` otherwise.

logout_token.description: Signed logout token (JWT) from the provider.

duration_seconds.description: Used when the video has no history entry yet; else the cached metadata's duration.

MemberPlace.description: Where a participant is in the app.

MemberSync.description: How well a participant's player keeps up with the room.

index.description: Zero-based target position; past the end moves the group to the end.
Zero-based target position; past the end moves the item to the end.
Zero-based target position; past the end moves the entry to the end.

key.description: Chosen by the client and unique within the queue: 1 to 64 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

OAuthError.description: OAuth 2.0 error response, as the back-channel logout spec asks for.

contains_video.description: Whether the playlist contains the video asked for with `video_id`; absent otherwise.

last_video_id.description: The item the owner last played, to continue from. Only shown to the owner.

thumbnails.description: Of the first item; empty for an empty playlist.

is_owner.description: Whether the signed-in user owns the playlist and so may change it.

PlaylistDetails.description: A playlist with its items, in order.

video.description: `channel` is always set; view counts and dates are not.

is_course.description: YouTube presents the playlist as a course.

ProgressReport.description: A progress report from the player.

oneOf.description: `null` if the video was never watched.

added_by.description: Display name of whoever queued it; empty for `autoplay` entries.

own.description:
Queued by this participant, or before with the same account or guest key; they may
always remove it.

video.description: `channel` is always set; view counts and dates are not.

start_seconds.description: Start offset in seconds for video links with a timestamp.

Retention.description: How long watch history entries are kept after they were last watched.

own.description: Sent by this participant, or before with the same account or guest key.

guest_key.description: Random 16 to 128 URL-safe characters a guest keeps, so a removal sticks.

name.description: Display name of a guest, 1 to 32 characters; ignored for signed-in users.

oneOf.description: Answered with `pong`, for estimating the server clock.

at.description:
Server time in ms since the epoch at which `position` was read, from the `pong`
clock; at most 5 s in the past. Defaults to when the server receives the message.

Server time in ms since the epoch at which `position` was read, from the `pong`
clock; at most 5 s in the past. Defaults to when the server receives the message.

oneOf.description: The current entry finished playing; the queue advances once, however many report it.
Skip the current entry.
Play a queued entry now.

play.description: Plays it now instead of queueing it; the current entry is dropped.

oneOf.description: Queues up to 100 videos in order, as many as fit; answered with `added`.

Moves an upcoming entry to index `to` of `queue`; `revision` is that of the state it
was based on. A newer room answers `stale` and stays as it is.
Puts the upcoming entries in a random order.

When the queue runs out, append a related video of the last entry that the room has not
queued before.
Owner only: removes a participant for the rest of the room's life.

Owner only: who may control playback and the queue, and who may add videos. Omitted
fields keep their setting.
A chat message of up to 500 characters; whitespace is collapsed.
Shown briefly over everyone's player.

What this participant's player and page are doing, for everyone's member list. Send it
on change; the server keeps the latest and passes it on at most once per second.
`null` while there is nothing to play.

RoomClientMessage.description: Sent by clients. The first message must be `join`; positions are in seconds.

is_owner.description: Whether the signed-in user created the room.

RoomListItem.description: One of the signed-in user's rooms.

active_at.description: Last time anyone was in the room; it expires a day after.

current_title.description: Title of the current video, if any.

thumbnails.description: Of the current video; empty without one.

oneOf.description: `null` until reported.
`null` until reported, or while there is nothing to play.

RoomPermission.description: Who besides the owner may do something.

RoomPermissions.description: What participants other than the owner may do.

add.description: Queue videos; playing one now needs `control` too.

control.description:
Play, pause, seek, skip, pick, reorder, shuffle, toggle autoplay and remove others'
entries.

oneOf.description: Answer to `join`, followed by `state`.
The whole room, after every change.
Played entries, newest first. Sent before the first `state` and whenever they change.
Answer to `add_many`. `skipped` videos were unavailable or did not fit in the queue.
The room's latest chat messages, oldest first. Sent before the first `state`.
A new chat message.

A participant's status changed. It replaces the one in `participants` if `revision` is
higher than that one's `status_revision`.
The owner removed this participant; the connection closes.
The room was closed or expired; the connection closes.
`null` once the queue has run out.

position.description: Seconds into the current video at `position_at`; add the time since while playing.

oneOf.description: What autoplay plays after `current`, once it is the last entry and a pick was found.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

corrected_query.description: Set when YouTube searched for a corrected query instead.

Settings.description: The signed-in user's preferences. The watch history pause lives at `/history/settings`.

audio_language.description:
Audio track to start with: `null` for the original audio, `interface` for the interface
language, else a language code such as `de` or `pt-BR`.

default_quality.description: Video height to start with; `null` for adaptive quality.

feed_hide_shorts.description: The subscription feed leaves out shorts.

feed_hide_watched.description: The subscription feed leaves out finished videos.

home_sections.description:
Enabled home page section keys in order; `null` for the default layout. Clients ignore
keys they do not know.

max_quality.description: Highest video height the player may pick; `null` for no limit.

video_codecs.description: Video codecs by preference, most preferred first; empty lets the player choose.

SettingsPatch.description: Fields to change. Absent fields are kept; `null` resets a field to its default.

audio_language.description: `interface` or a language code such as `de` or `pt-BR`.

home_sections.description: At most 32 distinct keys of lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

ShortDetails.description: What the shorts player shows over a short.

content_disclosures.description: YouTube's "How this was made" labels, e.g. altered or synthetic content.

oneOf.description: The full video the uploader linked to the short.

SkipMode.description: What the player does in a segment.

SponsorBlockSettings.description: SponsorBlock preferences. Missing fields take their defaults.

full_video_label.description: Label videos that are entirely about a product or service.

highlight.description: Mark the highlight and offer to jump to it.

SubscribedChannel.description: A channel the signed-in user subscribed to.

name.description:
`null` until the channel was fetched once, shortly after the first subscription,
unless an import provided it.

SubscriptionGroup.description: A group of subscribed channels, e.g. "Tech" or "Music".

channel_ids.description: Subscribed channels in the group (`UC…`); a channel can be in several groups.

show_on_home.description: Whether the home page shows a row with the group's feed.

id.description:
Unique per video: the language code, prefixed with `a.` if auto-generated, suffixed with
`.2`, `.3`… for further tracks of the same language and kind.

TrendingCategory.description: YouTube has no general trending list anymore, only these destination pages.

video.description: As sent by the client; view counts and dates are never set.

UpNextQueue.description: The signed-in user's up-next queue, in play order.

revision.description: Grows with every change, so clients can tell newer states from older ones.

UpdateGroup.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

UpdatePlaylist.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

audio_tracks.description: Empty when the player data could not be fetched or the video has a single track.

content_disclosures.description: YouTube's "How this was made" labels, e.g. altered or synthetic content.

description.description: Plain text; links are written out as URLs.

duration_seconds.description: Missing when the player data could not be fetched.

published_text.description: Localized, human-readable publish date as shown by YouTube.

storyboard_url.description: `WebVTT` thumbnails track for seek previews; absent without storyboard.

subtitles.description: Empty when the player data could not be fetched.

VideoProgress.description: How far the signed-in user got into a video.

updated_at.description: When the video was last watched.

segments.description: Sorted by start; empty when SponsorBlock is disabled or unreachable.

oneOf.description: Absent for auto-generated lists like albums.

is_course.description: YouTube presents the playlist as a course.

last_update_text.description: Localized text as shown by YouTube, e.g. `Last updated on Feb 16, 2026`.

video_count.description: As reported by YouTube; hidden unavailable videos make the list shorter.
